title: Avoiding Double Tee Cross-Flow in Waste Pipes
description: Using a standard double sanitary tee to connect two back-to-back fixtures into a drainage stack often leads to waste cross-flow. When water discharges rapidly from one side, it can shoot straight across the fitting into the opposing fixture trap rather than being directed downward. Professional plumbing standards require double fixture fittings or double combination fittings for back-to-back installations. This design ensures that waste flow is directed smoothly downward into the vertical stack without breaching the opposite drainage line or siphoning nearby trap seals.
